name: review-kit
description: The markdown review trio plus a folded-in dual-vault-sync engine. obsidian-versioned-review (green-mark co-authoring loop) and qa-audit (release QA log workflow) co-author and QA your docs; dual-vault-sync reconciles a small tier 1 set between laptop and mobile iCloud Obsidian, with a daily DRY-RUN mobile rolling-window prune so the phone vault stays tiny (real deletion is opt-in via --apply). Dormant until you track a doc.
